title: Glowing tulip
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4488' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff4488' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='petalGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6688'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff2244'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='petalGrad2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8899'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff4466'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='petalGrad3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffaa55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6622'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q48 68 49 58 Q50 52 50 48' stroke='#33cc55' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 78 Q52 68 51 58' stroke='#55ee77' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf left -->
  <path d='M49 65 Q35 58 32 48 Q40 50 49 62 Z' fill='#33cc55'/>
  <path d='M49 65 Q36 59 34 50' stroke='#55ee77' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- leaf right -->
  <path d='M51 70 Q65 62 68 54 Q60 56 51 68 Z' fill='#2bb34d'/>
  <path d='M51 70 Q64 63 66 56' stroke='#44dd66' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- petals - back left -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q30 40 28 22 Q38 24 48 40 Z' fill='url(#petalGrad2)'/>
  <!-- petals - back right -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q70 40 72 22 Q62 24 52 40 Z' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>

  <!-- petals - center back -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q42 32 50 14 Q58 32 50 48 Z' fill='url(#petalGrad3)'/>

  <!-- petals - front left -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q34 46 32 30 Q42 34 50 46 Z' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
  <!-- petals - front right -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q66 46 68 30 Q58 34 50 46 Z' fill='url(#petalGrad2)'/>

  <!-- petal highlights -->
  <path d='M48 42 Q40 36 38 28' stroke='#ffccdd' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M52 42 Q60 36 62 28' stroke='#ffccdd' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M50 44 Q48 30 50 18' stroke='#ffee77' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='100' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
